comments.body: I'm Taiwanese American and my in-laws are Swiss. I swear to God, the amount of racial microagressions I received in Switzerland in my 4 years of living there was more than I experienced in 30 years of living in the US. Not to mention literally casual racist remarks from my own MIL while visiting Taiwan. I generally think the development of racial awareness and sensitivity in CH is about 15-20 years behind North American standards.
comments.author: WeightPurple4515
